state_semantics.review: 待审查/审查中 — spawned reviewer round in flight (per-round detail = review_round dimension, C6/C7)
state_semantics.approved: 已审查 — pass terminal reached (review machine), task may be marked completed
state_semantics.completed: 已完成 — M7.4 completion protocol executed
state_semantics.committed: commit landed with the task ID in the message (M7.4 step 5) — terminal
state_semantics.blocked: escalation (T2 circuit breaker / T4 BLOCKED verdict)

transition_grounding.review->approved: behavior-protocol.md §4.6 T3 (APPROVED / APPROVED_WITH_NOTES unresolved_blockers=0 通过终态)
transition_grounding.review->dev: behavior-protocol.md §4.6 T1 (NEEDS_CHANGE 返工, round+1, 同一 Reviewer 复审)
transition_grounding.review->blocked: behavior-protocol.md §4.6 T2 (round>3 仍 NEEDS_CHANGE 熔断) / T4 (BLOCKED 终态)
transition_grounding.blocked->triaged: delivery verdict C 撤回规划 (version-plan §4 第一层) — back to planning

execution_unknown_semantics: 执行态 UNKNOWN — external action result unknown (e.g. push timeout); recovery MUST check the actual world state before re-running (effect-based: 查世界不信日志)
evaluation_not_evaluable_semantics: 评估态 NOT_EVALUABLE — evaluation basis invalid (baseline expired / scope changed / measurer incompatible); never silently mapped to pass
axis_separation_rule: UNKNOWN (execution axis) and NOT_EVALUABLE (evaluation axis) are distinct vocabularies on distinct axes and must never be conflated (arch round-2 §4 Q-4 精化)
continuation_rule: 评估结果与继续策略分离 — e.g. not_evaluable+advisory for trend gates, not_evaluable+block for release/safety/data-integrity gates
three_axis_rule: 实现状态 (task states) / 交付裁决 (delivery verdicts) / 运行姿态 (runtime postures) are separate axes — never merged into one 完成态 (arch round-3 P1-3)
